name: Notice:
description:
Important Notice Regarding Settings Layout Changes.
对于设置界面排版更改的重要告知。

name: English Ver.
description: NovaFlare Engine 1.2.2 increased settings text size, causing overflow. I adjusted the layout to fit the new engine. To restore the old layout, delete "settings.json" in "data", then rename "settings.json.old1-2-1" to "settings.json".

name: 中文版本
description:
由于 NovaFlare Engine 1.2.2 增大了设置界面的文字，部分设置项可能会超出
屏幕。因此我调整了文字排版以适应新版引擎，部分排版可能看起来不太整齐。
如果你使用旧版引擎或不喜欢新的排版，请删除模组 "data" 文件夹中的 "settings.json"，然后将 "settings.json.old1-2-1" 重命名为 "settings.json"。

name: Output Language
description:
Set ToolBox output language...
设置工具箱输出语言...

name: Debug ToolBox Settings
description:
Set your debug toolbox settings...
工具箱设置...

name: Enable Debug ToolBox
description:
If enabled, debugging shortcut keys can be used.
开启后可使用调试快捷键。

name: Soft Pause
description:
Enable Soft Pause. It can Soft Pause the game without pausing scripts.
开启后可软暂停游戏而不暂停脚本

name:
Independent
Scroll Speed
description:
When enabled, changing the playback rate will not affect the note scroll speed.
开启后调整播放速度时不会更改滚动速度。

name: Hide Tools Debug Print
description:
If enabled, debug shortcut key prints will be hidden.
开启后工具箱左上角的输出会被隐藏。

name:
Hide Tools Error/
Warn Prints
description:
If enabled, debug shortcut key error and warning prints will be hidden.
开启后工具箱左上角的报错和警告信息会被隐藏。

name: Change Botplay Text
description:
If disabled, using this tool to toggle the Botplay switch will not change the "botplayTxt.visible" state.
开启后使用工具箱开关Botplay时不会动"botplayTxt.visible"状态。

name: Showcase Mode
description:
Enable recording showcase mode. Hide HUD, judgement information, strums and hide judgement notes.
展示模式，开启后会隐藏ui，箭头，判定线等等元素，适合录屏。

name: Strum Alpha :
description:
Set the transparency of strum arrows during Showcase Mode. 0% disables this feature.
设置开启展示模式时判定线透明度，设为0%完全透明。

name:
Health Bar
      Alpha :
description:
Set the transparency of the health bar and icons during Showcase Mode.
0% disables this feature.
设置开启展示模式时血条和小图标透明度，设为0%完全透明。

name: Taunt Settings
description:
Can taunt opponent...
可以嘲笑对面这个老牧师的。

name:
Taunt
    Key  :
description:
Select the key used to taunt.
选择用于嘲笑的键盘按键。

name:
Taunt
    Character  :
description:
Select which character plays the "Hey" animation.
选择嘲笑时那个角色播放"Hey"动画。

name:
Taunt
    Duration  :
description:
Set how long the "Hey" animation lasts.
调整"Hey"动画的播放时长。

name:
"Hey" Sound
    Volume  :
description:
Set the volume of the "Hey" sound effect when taunting.
调整"Hey"音效的音量。

name: VSlice Style Settings
description:
Configure health bar smoothing and V-Slice style settings.
让你拥有像V-Slice那样的效果。

name: Health Bar Smoothing
description:
Smoothly interpolates health changes instead of applying them instantly.
开启后拥有更平滑的血条。

name:
Health Smooth
    Speed:
description:
Controls how quickly the displayed health follows the target health.
调整血条缓动的速度。

name: Opponent Health Drain
description:
Makes opponent notes reduce player health.
开启后对手可以推条(但是更平滑)。

name:
Opponent
     Drain Amount :
description:
Health reduced by a normal opponent note when Opponent Health Drain is enabled.
调整对手按一个箭头扣多少血。

name:
Opponent
     Drain Sustain :
description:
Health reduced by an opponent sustain note when Opponent Health Drain is enabled.
调整对手长按条每节扣多少血。

name: V-Slice Score Text
description:
Changes the score text style to match V-Slice.
开启后使用V-Slice那样的分数文字样式。

name:
Enable Sustain
   Note Reward
description:
If enabled, sustain notes can restore health and give score.
开启后长条可以回血以及获得分数。

name:
Sustain Health
    Amount:
description:
Health gained or lost for each sustain note tick.
调整长按条每节回多少血。

name: Hold Cover
description:
Enable the V-Slice-style hold cover effect.
开启后长按会有V-Slice那样的长按效果。

name:
Hold Cover
    Offset X :
description:
Additional X offset applied to all Hold Covers.
调整长按效果的X轴偏移(一般不用调)。

name:
Hold Cover
    Offset Y :
description:
Additional Y offset applied to all Hold Covers.
调整长按效果的Y轴偏移(一般不用调)。

name: Ghost Tap Settings
description:
Configure Ghost Tap punishment settings.
设置空敲频率限制。

name: Ghost Tap Punishment
description:
Enable Ghost Tap punishment. If disabled, Ghost Taps will not be counted or punished.
开启后限制空敲频率放止乱按。

name:
Ghost Tap
    Limit :
description:
Maximum number of Ghost Taps allowed within one second before punishment begins.
调整每秒允许的最大空敲次数，超过后每多按一次就会算作Miss。

name:
Ghost Tap
    Warning Color :
description:
Enable the Ghost Tap warning color effect on the player strums.
开启后随着空敲次数越来越多箭头会逐渐红温。

name:
Show Ghost Tap
    Count :
description:
Show the current Ghost Tap count on the HUD.
在屏幕下方显示空敲速度

name: -Other Settings-
description:
Others...
其他设置...

name: Disable Botplay
description:
If enabled, Botplay will be COMPLETELY disabled.
如果开启Botplay会被*完全禁用*防止开挂。

name: Miss Limit Count  :
description:
If the number of misses exceeds this value, you will immediately fail (in all songs). Set it to -1 to disable.
设置所有歌曲的最大Miss限制，超过就死。

name:
Score Text .
              Color ˙
description:
Set the score text color. Disable to allow other mods to modify it.
(Have 28 Colors!)
设置分数文字颜色，设"Disable"允许其他模组修改。(有28种颜色)

name: Blind Play :
description:
If enabled, will hide all notes during gameplay.
开启后隐藏音符实现盲打，搭配OneNote食用更佳。

name: One Note(Beta)
description:
Merge the four player note lanes into one lane. Any direction key can hit notes, simultaneous notes are merged into one, and Sustain Notes are automatically completed.
开启后可以玩到冰与火之舞，用一个或多个键玩FNF。

name: !Advanced Settings!
description:
If you don't know what the settings below are for, 
DON'T touch them!!!
如果你不懂的话别碰！！！

name:
OneNote Arrow .
                    Position ˙
description:
Set OneNote arrow position. 0 = Left, 0.5 = Center, 1 = Right.
设置OneNote的判定线位置。
0 = 左边，0.5 = 中间，1 = 右边

name: Rainbow Speed  :
description:
Adjust the color transition speed multiplier.
(only takes effect when the score text color is set to "Rainbow").
设置分数文字彩虹变化速度

name:
Custom ScoreText 
    Color(RGB)
description:
Set the RGB value of a custom score color.
(only takes effect when the score text color is set to "Custom").
自定义分数文字RGB颜色。

name: R  :
description:
Set the R value of a custom score RGB color.
设置自定义分数RGB颜色的R值。

name: G  :
description:
Set the G value of a custom score RGB color.
设置自定义分数RGB颜色的G值。

name: B  :
description:
Set the B value of a custom score RGB color.
设置自定义分数RGB颜色的B值。

name: Advanced Debug Mode
description:
Enable Advanced Debug Mode.
开启高级调试模式。

name:
Disable Engine
    Version Check
description:
If enabled, the script will no longer check whether the runtime environment is NovaFlare Engine. Under normal circumstances, 
*DO NOT* enable this option.
如果启用将不再检查运行环境是否为NF引擎。在正常情况下，*请勿*开启此选项。
